name: Тренажер пасток
description:
In this lesson, you are going to practice avoding falling into pittfalls. In each puzzle, there are two moves that seem equally good, but are not. One is a pitfall because the opponent can come up with a smart response. You will get miscelaneous puzzles from previous lessons.

If you want to practise a bit before trying, repeat the lesson(s) that you find difficult.

Start right away? Click on Play now. Good luck!

texts: Look for two targets. Compare the different options to capitalize.
